name: valve_eli_lift_ride
note: Black Mesa East's freight lift (d1_eli_01): the whole brick shaft (192 by 184 inside, from the top landing at z 0 down to the bottom landing at z -1456, and up to the cable head at +640), the freightelevator cage prop riding a func_tracktrain on seven path_tracks, the two-leaf doors at top and bottom (player clips behind elevatordoor props, lip 16, speed 100, wait 4), the gate props of the three floors passed at z -304, -592 and -880 (288 apart), cables, cage lights, call button props. Faces +y (the gates; the floors lie beyond them: valve_eli_lift_floor and the work-spot pieces); anchor on the top landing's floor at the middle of the gate plane. Its logic (46 entities: the ride's clock, the areaportals opened floor by floor, the shake and ding) is in 'wiring': docs/dev/prefabs.md, 'Pieces with their wiring'. Too tall for one piece with its floors, so the floors are their own pieces.
